function [E, N, d, delta_psi, heta, curvature] = guidance_law(P_N, P_E, psi, v, path, windowLen)

    persistent global_path path_length last_path old_length heta_filt
    
    if isempty(global_path)
        global_path = zeros(500000, 3);
        path_length = 0;
        last_path = zeros(500000, 3);
        old_length = 0;
        heta_filt = 0;
    end
    
    % 如果這次輸入的 path 不等於上次的，就加入累積
    if ~isempty(path) && ~isequal(path, last_path(1:old_length, :))
        new_len = size(path, 1);
        global_path(path_length+1:path_length+new_len, :) = path(:, :);
        path_length = path_length + new_len;
        last_path(1:new_len, :) = path(:, :);
        old_length = new_len;
    end
    path_CTE = global_path;

    r = 0;
    curvature = 0;
    d = 0;
    delta_psi = 0;
    heta = 0;

    % Use the waypoints in the given path
    numWps = size(path, 1);
    if numWps < 2
        N = P_N;
        E = P_E;
        return;
    end

    % ============================================================
    % 前瞻曲率（用滑窗 path 末端那一段來估）
    % ============================================================
    if numWps < 3
        curvature = 0;
    else
        % 調這兩個 
        previewDist = 0.9 * windowLen;  % 看視野最前端附近（90%處） 300*0.9=270
        spanDist    = max(10, 0.1 * windowLen); % 用 10%視野估曲率，至少10m,270*0.1=27,計算270m前後27m的曲率
        % ------------------------

        % 以 path 起點為 0，計算沿路徑累積距離（平面 E,N）
        xy = path(:,1:2);
        s  = [0; cumsum(sqrt(sum(diff(xy).^2,2)))];  % s(i) = 第 i 點距離 path(1) 的弧長
        L  = s(end);

        if L < 1e-6
            curvature = 0;
        else
            % 把 previewDist 限制在滑窗長度內
            s2 = min(max(previewDist, 0), L);
            s1 = max(s2 - spanDist/2, 0);
            s3 = min(s2 + spanDist/2, L);

            % 找到最接近 s1,s2,s3 的三個點索引
            [~, i1] = min(abs(s - s1));
            [~, i2] = min(abs(s - s2));
            [~, i3] = min(abs(s - s3));

            % 確保三點不重疊（避免除0）
            if numel(unique([i1 i2 i3])) < 3
                curvature = 0;
            else
                A = xy(i1,:); B = xy(i2,:); C = xy(i3,:);

                a = norm(B - C);
                b = norm(A - C);
                c = norm(A - B);

                % signed area2 = 2*Area (帶正負號可分左右轉)
                area2 = (B(1)-A(1))*(C(2)-A(2)) - (B(2)-A(2))*(C(1)-A(1));

                if a*b*c < 1e-9 || abs(area2) < 1e-9
                    curvature = 0;
                    r = 0;
                else
                    curvature = (2 * area2) / (a*b*c);   % signed curvature (1/m)
                    r = 1 / max(abs(curvature), 1e-9);
                end
            end
        end
    end
    % ============================================================

    margin = 30;  
    min_E = min(path(:,1)) - margin;
    max_E = max(path(:,1)) + margin;
    min_N = min(path(:,2)) - margin;
    max_N = max(path(:,2)) + margin;

    is_inside = (P_E >= min_E) && (P_E <= max_E) && ...
            (P_N >= min_N) && (P_N <= max_N);

    if is_inside
        extended_P = repmat([P_E, P_N], numWps, 1);
        differences = path(:, 1:2) - extended_P;
        distances = sqrt(sum(differences.^2, 2));
        
        % Find the closest waypoint
        [~, current_index] = min(distances);
        
        % Define target distance
        target_distance = 50;
        
        % Compute cumulative distances
        cumulative_distances = [0; cumsum(sqrt(sum(diff(path).^2, 2)))];
        remaining_distances = cumulative_distances(current_index+1:end) - cumulative_distances(current_index);
        
        % Determine target index
        if isempty(remaining_distances) || current_index + 1 > numWps
            k = numWps;
        else
            % Find the waypoint at the target distance
            [~, target_index_offset] = min(abs(remaining_distances - target_distance));
            
            if current_index + target_index_offset > numWps
                k = numWps;
            else
                k = current_index + target_index_offset;
            end
        end
        
        % Target waypoint
        N = path(k, 2); 
        E = path(k, 1); 
    
        % Compute cross-track error
        if current_index >= numWps
            x1 = path(numWps-1, 1);
            y1 = path(numWps-1, 2);
            x2 = path(numWps, 1);
            y2 = path(numWps, 2);
        else
            x1 = path(current_index, 1);
            y1 = path(current_index, 2);
            x2 = path(current_index+1, 1);
            y2 = path(current_index+1, 2);
        end
        
        D = sqrt((P_N - y1)^2 + (P_E - x1)^2);
        psi_r = atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        psi_c = atan2(P_N - y1, P_E - x1);
    
        if abs(psi_r - psi_c) < 1e-3
            d = 0; % 避免極小角度導致大誤差
        else
            d = abs(D * sin(psi_r - psi_c));
        end
           
        % Compute heading difference
        psi_cmd = atan2(N - P_N, E - P_E);
        heta = psi_cmd - psi;
        heta = mod(heta + pi, 2 * pi) - pi;
    
        L1 = sqrt((N - P_N)^2 + (E - P_E)^2);
        a_cmd = 2 * v^2 / L1 * sin(heta);
        delta_psi = a_cmd / v;

    else  % ~is_inside
        
        numWaypoints = size(path_CTE, 1);
        % Calculate distances to all waypoints
        extended_P = repmat([P_E, P_N], numWaypoints, 1);
        differences = path_CTE(:, 1:2) - extended_P;
        distances = sqrt(sum(differences.^2, 2));
        
        % Find the closest waypoint
        [~, current_index] = min(distances);
        
        % Define target distance
        target_distance = 30;
        uav_pos = [P_E, P_N];
        path_points = path(:,1:2);
        point_dists = vecnorm(path_points - uav_pos, 2, 2);
        [~, k] = min(abs(point_dists - target_distance));
        
        % Target waypoint
        E = path(k, 1); 
        N = path(k, 2); 
    
        % Compute cross-track error
        if current_index >= numWaypoints
            x1 = path_CTE(numWaypoints-1, 1);
            y1 = path_CTE(numWaypoints-1, 2);
            x2 = path_CTE(numWaypoints, 1);
            y2 = path_CTE(numWaypoints, 2);
        else
            x1 = path_CTE(current_index, 1);
            y1 = path_CTE(current_index, 2);
            x2 = path_CTE(current_index+1, 1);
            y2 = path_CTE(current_index+1, 2);
        end
        
        D = sqrt((P_N - y1)^2 + (P_E - x1)^2);
        psi_r = atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        psi_c = atan2(P_N - y1, P_E - x1);
    
        if abs(psi_r - psi_c) < 1e-3
            d = 0; % 避免極小角度導致大誤差
        else
            d = abs(D * sin(psi_r - psi_c));
        end
    
        % Compute heading difference
        psi_cmd = atan2(N - P_N, E - P_E);
        heta = psi_cmd - psi;
        heta = mod(heta + pi, 2 * pi) - pi;
        if heta_filt == 0
            heta_filt = heta;
        end
        alpha = 0.85;
       
        heta_filt = alpha * heta_filt + (1 - alpha) * heta;
        heta = heta_filt;
    
        L1 = sqrt((N - P_N)^2 + (E - P_E)^2);
        a_cmd = 2 * v^2 / L1 * sin(heta);
        delta_psi = a_cmd / v;
    end
end
